sahneler.anlatim: Rainbow Six Siege's new season, Operation Vital Signal, lands on December 1.
According to Ubisoft's Steam announcement, this is the fourth season of Year 11, and the headline change is Doc.

veri.alinti: The season arrives on December 1, and its headline change is a full remaster of Doc.

sahneler.anlatim: Doc loses the Stim Pistol and gains the E-Heal Monitor. He can heal a patched teammate from across the map, or revive them if they are down.
Ranked is split into two playlists with separate ranks: Solo/Duo and Flex. The clearance level to enter drops from 50 to 30.

maddeler.metin: Solo/Duo: queue alone or as a pair
Flex: squads of two, three or five

sahneler.anlatim: The new MBZ-19 submachine gun fires 750 rounds per minute, holds 64 rounds and deals 33 damage per bullet.

veri.not: Warden, Thunderbird and Jäger can equip it.

sahneler.anlatim: Shotguns go the other way: the ACS12 falls from 69 to 45 damage, and the TCSG12 from 75 to 50.
The current Battle Pass closes when the season starts, so claim any remaining rewards before December 1.

veri.not: Claim your remaining rewards before this date.

sahneler.anlatim: All the map and weapon changes are on our site, Control A Game.

veri.alt: Sources and map updates are in the article.
